findings_zh: v6相对v5的唯一科学计算改变为轨道Newton/AH内层ah_conv_tol从默认1e-12收紧到1e-22，另改监督器路径并增加实际是否使用AH等元数据。
物理泛函、基组、原子几何、网格、积分screening、外层SCF能量1e-12/轨道梯度1e-9及最终独立Fock范数1e-8资格没有放宽；methodsettings和点/中心配组代码逐函数AST相同。
精确installed CIAH数学函数的离线SPD模型复现了默认容差提前接受不完整子空间、末次dxi缩成近零、下一宏循环子空间被丢后旋转严格为0；更严格子容差能在相同外层梯度门槛内收敛。
离线toy可支持修复假设，不可替代分子真实失败位移点的实际SCF和核梯度验收；之前中心案例初始梯度已低于门槛，不能证明AH对超阈值残差真正有效。
minimum_runtime_acceptance_gate: Use at least one actual previously FAILED displaced-point checkpoint with hash/geometry/method lineage; a center-only test is insufficient.
Keep MF/qualified-center actual quadrature and method settings bound; no old failure or charge may be overwritten.
Require true solver convergence, finite complete nuclear gradients, independent fresh-Fock norm<=1e-8, real wait4 closure/cost and output seals.
Record whether AH was actually used and its starting/terminal gradient. A CDIIS-only smoke proves recovery of that point but does not itself prove the molecular AH repair mechanism.
Complete and verify the opposite signed partner before treating the pair as a directional curvature observation, and preserve the same qualified center E0.
Release the batch only after the selected real failed-point smoke passes; toy-only or already-stationary-center success is not enough.

relevant_regressions_inspected: strict inner AH tolerance reaches smaller actual linear residual against exact SPD solve
actual AH not used when CDIIS finishes
small seed discarded by metric threshold

review_scope: Static source/AST/hash review and exact byte copies only in this task. Prior diagnostic files used only NumPy/SciPy linear algebra extracted from installed source. No new molecular SCF/Fock/integral/grid/gradient/Hessian kernel or Git mutation, and no old artifact rewrite.
limitations: The review does not certify all molecular modes, a global electronic state, nuclear minimum, full corrected Hessian, IR intensities or chemical peak assignment.
Actual molecular runtime acceptance is pending; a mathematical toy cannot guarantee budget or convergence.
